title: What Have You Done, Lord?
lyrics_original: "What has the Lord done for us,
that we will conquer the grave?"
You bore our own sins, Lord,

bible_verses.english: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
All we like sheep have gone astray. Everyone has turned to his own way; and Yahweh has laid on him the iniquity of us all.

But when this corruptible will have put on incorruption, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is written will come to pass: “Death is swallowed up in victory.” “O Death, where is your sting? O Hades, where is your victory?”

devotional.prayer_english: Lord, I confess how easily I wander and seek my own praise instead of Yours. Thank You for loving me even when I was far off, and for coming to rescue me when I couldn't save myself. You have conquered the grave and given me life eternal. Teach me to walk daily in awe of what You have done for me. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord, I confess how easily I wander and seek my own praise instead of Yours. devotional.reflection_english: We often wander like sheep, chasing our own desires and forgetting the depth of God's love. Yet, even when we turned our backs, Jesus came looking for us. Through His profound sacrifice on the cross, He didn't just meet us in our brokenness—He disarmed death and rewrote our eternity. As you sing today, let your heart marvel at His grace and step into the incredible victory He has won for you.
